claim_one_line: THE DEDEKIND PHASE, VERIFIED AND SCOPED ON MAIN (re-banks the referee lane's sealed arc, numbered B1669 on its branch; seal 20ed2c300 intact, the deterministic cells re-executed, every identity checked independently): in a symmetric zero-diagonal sector the masses obey m1 = m2 + m3 (B1636; e1^2 = 4 e2 symbolically), so the parameter-free sectors (the weight-one O+ coupling and the identity) have m2/m1 >= 1/2 at every tau -- no hierarchy; no Cabibbo angle in them, from the dimension fact (both sectors one-dimensional at the minimal weights); det Y1 = 8 eta^6 and the higher determinants are eta^6 times level-one forms; with real coefficients the strong-CP phase is 12 arg eta(tau) = pi Re tau + O(|q|) (1.7e-6 at Im tau = 2.5, 2.1e-2 at Im tau = 1). For a general zero-diagonal coupling the sum rule fails (min m2/m1 = 0.128). 0 of 19.
